title: Name pi-durable in a hosted attempt's handle and the cloud profiles
body:
A hosted attempt's job handle names the dispatch's requested harness ('pi', from profiles-cloudflare-sandbox) because the Go client refuses a handle whose harness differs from the request (internal/exec/cloudflaresandbox/executor.go:431). The attempt actually runs on pi-durable (WorkerAgentState.harness). The cloud profiles' runner and the boot env's TICKS_HARNESS should say pi-durable once the pi-CLI path is deleted (jhp), so provenance names what ran.
evidence: cloudflare/src/sandbox-executor.ts startHostedAttempt (harness: bootedHarness(boot))
